items.title: Brand orange fails AA text contrast system-wide
items.detail: From the a754d887d systematic pass (applies wherever brand orange tokens are used, including this demo): white-on-orange 2.93:1 and orange-on-white/#F0F0F0 2.57–2.93:1. Cursor axe already flagged orange Contact me / legal / chrome on this URL. Design-system fix.
items.fix: Ship contrast-safe brand text and on-orange button tokens (≥4.5:1 normal, ≥3:1 large).
items.verified: Claude systematic on a754d887d; Cursor axe contrast on be2376b21

items.title: Opt-In tooltip stuck open blocks the toggle
items.fix: Dismiss tooltip on blur/Escape/outside-click; fix z-index/hit-testing so it never captures pointer events over the toggle.

items.title: Topic-rating checkboxes are 0×0px and skipped by Tab
items.fix: Give inputs real dimensions matching visible icons so they re-enter the Tab sequence.

items.title: Topic-rating inputs use checkbox semantics for radio behavior
items.fix: Convert to radiogroup/radio (or native radios) with aria-labels for Very / Somewhat / Not important.

items.title: Modal close (X) has no accessible name
items.fix: Add aria-label="Close" on shared modal-header close component.

items.title: Required fields lack required / aria-required
items.detail: Guest form shows required styling on First name, Last name, Email, Country, and Phone Number. Most inputs have no aria-required; Country’s visible input uses HTML required but is unlabelled. Empty phone blocks Continue with “Phone number is required to continue”.
items.fix: Add aria-required="true" (or required) at the shared form-field component; keep error text linked via aria-describedby.

items.title: Opt-In toggle has no accessible name
items.detail: On the new-viewer form, input[data-testid="optin toggle"] is still 0×0 with no accessible name; axe label rule fires. Visible “Opt In” text is not programmatically associated.
items.fix: Associate label via for/id or aria-labelledby pointing at "Opt In" text; give the control a real hit target.

items.title: Corrupted / duplicated legal disclaimer text
items.detail: API /legal/statements?country=US returns the same corrupted string (“…gitimate Interes…”). Still shown beside the guest form.
items.fix: Fix source copy / template once; re-check contrast after rewrite.
items.verified: Confirmed again during guest registration; same payload from legal/statements API

items.title: No established labeling pattern for icon-only controls
items.fix: Standardize visible or visually-hidden labels; use reaction bar as reference.

items.title: Focus visibility gaps: Opt-In / Seek / Volume still missing; some rings fail contrast
items.detail: Systematic a754d887d pass corrected earlier false negatives: reaction bar, Contact me (player), and Adjust my selections DO have box-shadow rings. Remaining gaps: Opt-In toggle (no style via any of 3 mechanisms), Seek + Volume (none), Select-all / Contact me on Topic Rating. Reaction ring exists but measures 1.34–1.76:1 over video. Lead fields use border-color, not outline.
items.fix: Define one :focus-visible token (≥3:1) and apply to Opt-In, Select all, Seek, Volume; strengthen reaction-bar ring contrast.

items.title: Opt-In consent modal missing dialog accessible name / semantics
items.fix: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby on a real heading.

items.title: Button spinner progressbar has no accessible name
Country dropdown lacks combobox/listbox semantics
items.detail: Visible control is input[data-testid="field country"] with no accessible name (axe label). Suggestions render as div.option without role=option / listbox. Hidden country_autofill is aria-hidden. Nearby UIKit anchor uses aria-expanded/aria-haspopup without an allowed role (axe aria-allowed-attr).
items.fix: Implement ARIA 1.2 combobox pattern: labelled input, listbox + option roles, and wire aria-expanded to the combobox.
items.verified: Cursor guest form + Claude a754d887d (listbox/option OK; missing combobox/aria-expanded)

items.title: Phone field appears only after Country and is easy to miss
items.detail: Phone Number is visually required and gates Continue, but it is not in the initial field set until Country resolves. Screen readers / keyboard users can believe the form is complete while Continue stays disabled.
items.fix: Keep phone in the initial required field order (or announce the newly required field via live region when Country is set).
items.verified: Cursor: Continue stayed disabled until phone filled; error “Phone number is required to continue”

items.title: Header prev/next chevrons have no accessible name
Lead-capture / new-viewer form opens without a clear focus move
items.detail: “I’m new here” reveals form[aria-label="new viewer form"]. Cursor reached and submitted this path; Claude’s separate lead-capture modal focus finding still applies to gated flows that use a dialog.
items.fix: Move focus to first field or form heading on open; ensure dialog variant uses aria-labelledby.
items.verified: Cursor completed guest submit → personalized player (b6bd9c4bf)

items.title: Color contrast below WCAG AA on legal text and player chrome (see also P0-5)
items.detail: Cursor axe node-level shots remain useful evidence; root cause for brand-orange text is tracked in P0-5.
items.fix: See P0-5 — raise contrast to ≥4.5:1 (3:1 large text).

items.title: Opt-In explanation only available via tooltip
items.fix: Replace with always-visible helper copy under the toggle.

items.title: Topic-rating icons need segmented-control redesign
items.fix: Connected pill group with hit area matching visible control.
